sharedPassages.label: 大問3A
sharedPassages.text:
Notice about Social Studies Homework

Please write a report by next Wednesday’s social studies class!

Each student should visit a factory, museum, farm, or station this Saturday or

Sunday and interview the workers. Choose your favorite place! Before

visiting, you must call the office and tell the staff that you would like to

interview them.

During the interviews, you should ask the following questions:

•What do you do in your daily work? •What is the most difficult part of your work?

If you have any questions, please visit Ms. White this Thursday. However,

she is absent in the morning this week, so visit her in the afternoon!

From: Alex Long To: Ben Long Date: June 15 Subject: My brother Daniel

Dear Grandpa, I wanted to go to your house today with my younger brother Daniel, but I can’t go with him. We fought this morning! Our fight was about our favorite video game. Mom also got angry because Daniel didn’t do his homework, so he went to the library to finish it an hour ago! Can I go to your house alone? Are you at home this afternoon? I can go to your house by bus today! Write soon, Alex

From: Ben Long To: Alex Long Date: June 15 Subject: Are you OK?

Dear Alex, Is everyone OK? I hope you’re all happy. I’ve just received an email from Daniel. I think he feels sorry for you and your mom. Daniel also thinks he’ll finish his homework today, so why don’t you come to my house with him tomorrow? Also, you always come to my house by bike, right? Why do you want to come here by bus today? I’m at home today, but if you come tomorrow, your grandma will make a fruitcake. We can eat it together! One of my friends will give me many fruits tomorrow morning! Keep in touch, Grandpa

From: Alex Long To: Ben Long Date: June 15 Subject: OK!

Dear Grandpa, Thank you for telling me about Daniel. When he comes home from the library, I’ll say sorry to him! OK, I won’t go to your house today. I’ll visit you with Daniel tomorrow afternoon instead. Yes, I want to eat Grandma’s fruitcake! Daniel will be happy, too! Now, something is wrong with my bike. question: The gray wolf

originalContent.body: The gray wolf

sharedPassages.label: 大問3C
sharedPassages.text:
Gray Wolves

The gray wolf is an animal that can be found in North America, Europe, Asia, and other areas. Gray wolves live in forests, snowy places, and other places. Gray wolves used to live all across the United States, but recently, most gray wolves have only lived in the northern areas of North America. In the 1970s, only a few hundred gray wolves lived in the southern area of the United States.

The main reason the gray wolves disappeared is that they were hunted by humans. In the 1800s, humans went to live in the western areas of the United States and cut down trees to build houses. Therefore, the gray wolves lost their homes and had to go to new places close to humans’ houses. They ate people’s pets or animals on people’s farms. Humans did not like this, so they hunted the gray wolves. Then, the number of gray wolves decreased.

This created a new problem in the 1900s. Gray wolves originally ate animals in the forests. However, because there were fewer gray wolves, other animals lived longer. These animals ate many plants. People realized gray wolves helped the forests by eating the animals that ate the plants.

In 1974, the American government made a new rule. The rule said no one could kill or hurt gray wolves. Because of this, in just forty years, the population of gray wolves grew in the southern areas of America. The gray wolves helped the environment a lot. The number of other animals decreased, and the number of plants increased.

explanation:
正答は4。冒頭でNorth America, Europe, Asiaなどにいるとあるので、欧州で見られるが合う。

森以外に雪のある場所などにも暮らすとあるので、onlyが合わない。

choiceExplanations.ア: 森以外に雪のある場所などにも暮らすとあるので、onlyが合わない。
choiceExplanations.イ: 雪のある地域にも暮らすとあり、寒い所を好まないとは述べていない。
choiceExplanations.ウ: ペットを食べた話はあるが、オオカミ自身がペットだったとは書かれていない。
choiceExplanations.エ: 冒頭でNorth America, Europe, Asiaなどにいるとあるので、欧州で見られるが合う。

question:
